name: 44305 · Akron, OH
findings: ZIP 44305 (Akron) has 77 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 15 organizations.
Community organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44305 (Akron) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 44305 (Akron) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).
